about: Flashcards (Josh, 2026-10-21): a production candidate, not used by the app yet. One card per word: the word with its article, the English, which sense the card teaches, and the picture (a scene that shows that sense without any writing in it). Images: 1:1, generated at 2k, saved 1200 x 1200 JPEG.

cards.picture: An espresso in a small white cup on its saucer, on a marble bar counter
An open dictionary on a café table, one entry circled in pencil, the print too small to read

cards.note: Also bench, bank; the bar counter is where a newcomer meets it
cards.picture: A wooden bar counter with a few espresso cups and a sugar bowl, a barista's hands behind it
A small piazza at dusk, street lamps just lit, people strolling, the sky deep blue and orange

cards.note: Most often met in Cosa? (What?); the card teaches the noun
cards.picture: A table with a jumble of everyday things: keys, a cup, a book, a ball of string, sunglasses

cards.note: Una volta, tre volte; not time on a clock
cards.picture: Three identical espresso cups in a row on a counter, as if ordered three times
A few euro coins and a folded note on a small saucer by a till

cards.note: Two everyday senses: non ho tempo, che tempo fa?
cards.picture: A town clock tower against a sky half sunny and half rainy
A wooden pepper grinder beside a little heap of black peppercorns
A wheel of pecorino with a wedge cut out, on a wooden board
A round pizza on a table with one slice taken out

cards.en: reason; avere ragione = to be right
cards.note: Most met in Hai ragione! (You're right!)
cards.picture: Two friends at a café table, one conceding with open hands and a smile while the other makes a point
A father walking hand in hand with his young son down a lane
A hunk of cheese being grated over a plate of pasta
A cornetto on a small plate beside a cappuccino
Ripe red tomatoes on the vine in a market crate
A small group chatting animatedly at an outdoor café, hands in motion
A regional train pulling into a small station platform

A bowl of ripe apricots, one cut in half showing the stone
